description: This file contains the implementation of classes and functions for reading and parsing Mach-O binary files, including fat binaries, with detailed error reporting and segment/section handling within the Google Breakpad project.

classes.name: FatReader
classes.description: Class for reading and parsing fat binary files, including error reporting.

classes.name: FatReader::Reporter
classes.description: Class for reporting errors related to fat binary headers and object files.

classes.name: Reader
classes.description: Class for reading and parsing Mach-O files, including handling load commands, segments, and sections.

classes.name: Reader::Reporter
classes.description: Class for reporting errors during Mach-O file parsing.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Structure representing a section within a Mach-O segment.

classes.name: SectionMap
classes.description: Type alias for a map of section names to Section structures.

methods.name: FatReader::Read
methods.description: Reads and parses a fat binary buffer, identifying contained object files or Mach-O headers.

methods.name: Reader::Read
methods.description: Reads and parses a Mach-O binary buffer, verifying headers and load commands.

methods.name: Reader::WalkLoadCommands
methods.description: Iterates over load commands in the Mach-O header, invoking a handler.

methods.name: Reader::FindSegment
methods.description: Finds a segment by name within the Mach-O file.

methods.name: Reader::WalkSegmentSections
methods.description: Iterates over sections within a segment, invoking a handler.

methods.name: Reader::MapSegmentSections
methods.description: Creates a map of section names to sections within a segment.
